headline: Yi-Chia Chen's Fields Model closes to 0.84 behind Tufa Labs at the top of ARC-2

sections.text: Fields Model, Yi-Chia Chen's team, gained 2.50 in the past day to reach 87.22 and sits second on the ARC-2 board. Tufa Labs still leads at 88.06, unchanged, so the gap at the top is 0.84.

Yi-Chia Chen's public Kaggle profile also lists a write-up of a third-place solution in the Eedi mathematics competition. Public standings are provisional, and medals are decided on the private board.
